label: Integration failure-mode assurance
formula: 100 × verified required protections / required applicable protections
note: Confirmed scope/cohort and source evidence not supplied.

label: Source-to-outcome traceability
formula: 100 × traceable outcomes / outcomes in the confirmed cohort
note: Confirmed scope/cohort and source evidence not supplied.

label: Critical data-rule assurance
formula: 100 × verified critical data rules / applicable critical data rules
note: Confirmed scope/cohort and source evidence not supplied.

label: Critical contract assurance
formula: 100 × verified critical contract obligations / required critical contract obligations
note: Confirmed scope/cohort and source evidence not supplied.

label: Enforced automation of critical controls
formula: 100 × critical controls with fully automated assertions and enforced current passing runs / critical controls
note: Confirmed scope/cohort and source evidence not supplied.

label: Critical escape incidence
formula: 100 × mature releases with a confirmed critical escape / mature deployed releases
note: Confirmed scope/cohort and source evidence not supplied.

label: Actionable QA feedback lead time
formula: p50 / p90 elapsed hours from agreed test readiness to first actionable QA feedback; waiting shown separately
note: Confirmed scope/cohort and source evidence not supplied.

label: AI first-review acceptance
formula: 100 × first reviews accepted without material correction / completed first reviews
note: Confirmed scope/cohort and source evidence not supplied.

label: Observed AI effort change
formula: 100 × (comparable baseline minutes − assisted minutes including review/rework) / comparable baseline minutes
note: Confirmed scope/cohort and source evidence not supplied.
